study: The marked %R turn. Both lines leave a one-minute trough together, the fast line is still underneath, the pitches are the same or the fast pitch is steeper, and the five-minute pitches do not say no.
question: Does that turn, exited by the already frozen minute trail, beat a later minute of the same name and a same-minute other name, in both halves, after a 10 bp round trip?
operator_sentence: then score the turn I marked
marked_turn: The turn named to the operator on 2026-10-26 before this file: the lines leaving a trough together, same pitch or fast steeper while the fast line is still underneath, and a 5-minute pitch that does not say no. The boxed DAL and VRT sessions of 2026-10-26 are not in the warehouse. This file does not replay those two charts and does not tune a lag to them.
registered_at: 2026-10-26 18:08 ET, before any script of this rule and before any return of it was computed.
origin: pitch_open_v2 and pitch_trail_v2 scored a wider 1-minute state: both pitches at least +0.1 and the fast pitch at least the slow pitch within 5 tenths, including minutes where the fast line was already above the slow line, with no trough and no five-minute check. That state fired about 8 times a name a day. Both of those studies are closed FAILs. Their preregs, scripts, and result files are not edited. This is a new entry. The exit is the pitch_trail_v2 minute trail, called and not rewritten.
prior: LOW. The closed pitch union and the closed pitch trail are in this family, and every earlier scored %R entry on this book was about 0 bp before the spread. A pass here does not erase those nulls. The pass bar is not loosened.
what_is_graded: One predicate, turn(t). It is true only when the trough, the marked shape, and the five-minute permission are all true. Otherwise false. A missing input is false. There is no second grade and there are no information cells.

lines.fast: Williams %R(21) then EMA span 7, pandas ewm(adjust=False). Use pitch_open.lines. Do not import signals.py or ai_entry_watch.py. Do not edit pitch_open.py.
lines.slow: Williams %R(112) then EMA span 3, the same function.
lines.feed: PRIMARY lines are warehouse IEX. Every price is warehouse SIP. --lines sip recomputes the lines on SIP and is information. It has no pass of its own and runs only after the IEX verdict is PASS or FAIL.

pitch_1m.pair: pitch_open.pair. At a real minute t, a pitch exists only when t-1 is also a real line-feed minute and both lines are finite at t and at t-1.
pitch_1m.formula: round(line(t) - line(t-1), 1), Python round, half even, then f = int(round(fast_pitch * 10)) and s = int(round(slow_pitch * 10)). The divisor is 1. A 2-minute gap is not divided by 2. round(0.15, 1) is 0.1 and round(2.05, 1) is 2.0. A raw +0.04 is 0.0 and is not up. A raw +0.05 is +0.1 and is up.
pitch_1m.up: A tenth > 0 is up. 0 and negative are not up.

trough: pair(t-1) exists and both tenths are <= 0. Both lines were flat or falling over that one real minute. One line still rising is not a trough. A missing pair(t-1) is not a trough. The trough is one minute. A longer trough is a different prereg.

shape.rule: pair(t) exists, f > 0, s > 0, fast(t) < slow(t), and f + 5 >= s. fast(t) < slow(t) is strict and is on the %R scale, so the fast line is still under the slow line. Equal line values are not under. f + 5 >= s is the same integer union as pitch_open: same is abs(f - s) <= 5, and fast-steeper is f > s + 5. Same-pitch with the fast line already above the slow line is not this turn.
shape.frozen: Not from the market. Lines are fast value, slow value, f, s. (-40, -20, 5, 5) is in. (-40, -20, 9, 3) is in. (-40, -20, 8, 3) is in, because abs(8 - 3) = 5. (-40, -20, 3, 8) is in, because abs = 5. (-40, -20, 2, 8) is out. (-20, -40, 9, 3) is out. (-20, -40, 5, 5) is out. (any, any, 0, 5) is out. Prior tenths (0, 0), (-1, 0), and (0, -3) are a trough. Prior (1, 0) and (0, 1) are not.

pitch_5m.pair: Minute t-5 must be a real line-feed minute exactly five clock minutes before t, with both lines finite at t and at t-5. A missing t-5 is not a five-minute pitch. The study does not use the fifth earlier real bar when that bar is not t-5, and it does not divide a 4-minute or 6-minute gap by 5.
pitch_5m.formula: rate = (line(t) - line(t-5)) / 5, then round(rate, 1), then tenths by int(round(that * 10)). The same Python round as the one-minute pitch. Interior minutes t-4, t-3, and t-2 may be missing. t-1 is already required by the trough.
pitch_5m.does_not_say_no: Both five-minute tenths are > 0. Either tenth <= 0 says no, and turn(t) is false. The five-minute pitches do not have to be the same and do not have to be meeting. Permission is only that neither line is flat or falling over those five minutes.
pitch_5m.frozen: A change of +0.25 over those five minutes is a rate of +0.05, which rounds to +0.1, tenth 1, and is up. A change of +0.20 is a rate of +0.04, which rounds to 0.0, and says no. A change of -0.25 rounds to -0.1 and says no.

onset.fire: pitch_trail.onset_minutes on turn(t). Fire when turn(t) is true and turn(t-1) is false. turn(t) requires both tenths at t-1 to be <= 0, and turn(t-1) requires both tenths at t-1 to be > 0, so a true turn(t) already has turn(t-1) false. The onset walker still runs.
onset.before_the_window: The predicate is read on earlier RTH minutes so the first in-window minute can be a continuation. A pre-window minute does not set the clock.
onset.clock: One run_clock per symbol. A SIP open of t+1 above 0 and a trail_exit price is a fill: lock until that exit minute even when a control gross is missing and the row is not scored. A missing open or a walk with no price is a miss: lock = signal + 14, and no position is opened. Each control gross is that walk's own exit price over that walk's own entry open, minus 1.
onset.window: Signal minute t from 09:45 (585) through 15:20 (920) inclusive.

data: The pitch_open_v2 warehouse rules, unchanged. Intersection days FIRST 2026-05-11 through LAST 2026-10-15. Half A is day <= 2026-07-29. Half B is after. A session needs a previous intersection day. Universe is every name in that day's SIP file. Skip and count: no line feed, no previous line-feed session, split jump abs(today first SIP open / previous last SIP close - 1) > 0.30, no warmup, bad_line_series. Do not fetch sessions after 2026-10-15. Do not read warehouse_confirm.
entry: SIP open of t+1. The open must be > 0. Otherwise the onset is a miss, it is counted, and the 15-minute clock is set.
exit: Pass trail_exit, same_name_minutes, and other_names a SIP bar (open, high, low, close), never pitch_open's (open, close) pair, and do not re-code the walk. A minute with no positive open adds 60 idle seconds and does not trade, except 949 still flattens. Idle clears when the close is <= the fill. The leash can sell when the close is > the fill. A blocked leash sets the stop to max(stop, round(close, 2)).
gross: exit_price / entry_open - 1. Cost 10 bp (0.0010) is the grade. Lift is gross minus control gross, so the flat cost cancels in the lift and binds in the net.

controls.seed: pitch_open.seeded(sym, day, entry_min, tag) with entry_min = t+1. One choice. No redraw.
controls.same_name: pitch_trail.same_name_minutes. Ascending minutes from entry+1 through min(entry+60, 949) that can fill and can exit. Tags ptrough-d and ptrough-d2. ptrough-d2 is the MDE draw. The control runs the same trail.
controls.other_name: pitch_trail.other_names. The day's SIP symbols sorted ascending, excluding the traded name, with a positive open at the trade's entry minute and a trail exit. Tags ptrough-x and ptrough-x2.
controls.scored_row: A scored row, and only a scored row, has pop "primary" and numeric fields gross, d, d2, x, and x2, the grosses from tags ptrough-d, ptrough-d2, ptrough-x, and ptrough-x2. Pass every scored row from both halves to canary_deltas. Pass each half's scored rows to ladder, and pass those two ladder dicts to overall unchanged. The floor calls are mde(half, "d", "d2") and mde(half, "x", "x2").
controls.declared_bias: Later-minute controls on this universe run about +1 bp in the trade's favour. The bar is not loosened by 1 bp. The minute trail sells a green minute that is not a new high, which is harsher than the live 15-second leash. That bias stays. It is not switched after the count.

statistic: pitch_open.ladder and pitch_open.overall. Inside a half, the day-equal mean of (trade gross - control gross), then eod_reversal.stats. The net is the day-equal mean of (gross - 0.0010).
pass: BOTH halves, on scored rows. lift_d mean >= +5 bp and t >= 2. lift_x mean >= +5 bp and t >= 2. Day-equal net after 10 bp > 0. For each lift separately: drop the 3 days with the highest day-mean of that lift, tie broken by the day string ascending, and the remaining mean is >= 0. For each lift separately: drop the 5 symbols with the largest sum of that lift, tie broken by the symbol string ascending, and the remaining mean is >= 0. A null mean on a drop fails. Floors must already have passed or --score does not print means.
fail: FAIL if t <= -2 on either lift in either half, or either lift's 97.5% upper bound is < +5 bp in both halves, or the net upper bound is < 0 in both halves. A null upper bound does not satisfy a both-halves clause. Any other powered result is UNDERPOWERED. One passing half is not a pass.
power: Per half, on scored rows: >= 300 trades, >= 20 days, and MDE <= 5 bp for both control pairs. MDE is pitch_open.mde. A null MDE fails the floor. If either half misses a floor, --score prints UNDERPOWERED and no means.
count_step: Per half: scored trades, days, mde_d, mde_x, floors_met, and skip counts. No gross, no net, no lift, no t, no upper bound. rows.json may be written for a later --score. Do not open it before --score. The cache is reused only when the sha256 of this prereg and of pitch_trough.py, pitch_trail.py, pitch_open.py, eod_reversal.py, and indicator_confirm_hist.py all match.
canary: After the count and before --score, add 0.0010 to a copy of the scored grosses with pitch_open.canary_deltas. Print only the change in the day-equal net, lift_d, and lift_x, per half. Each change must be within 1e-9 of +0.0010. Do not write the lifted rows back. --score refuses without canary_ok on the same module shas and the same prereg sha.
confirmation: A PASS is not a desk change. Next is result-skeptic Mode 2, then a new forward paper prereg. should_arm_buy stays as it is. The hover stays display-only. No bot_config key is added.
no_retuning: The one-minute trough, the underneath cut, the 5-tenth band, the exact t-5 divisor of 5, the trail walk, the 15-minute miss clock, the window, the 10 bp grade, the two controls, the halves, and the floors are fixed. Another lag, a resampled five-minute %R, or a longer trough is a new prereg.
if_pass: Stop. Do not change the arm. Do not write a finding markdown until Mode 2 returns.
if_fail: This turn is closed as an entry on this warehouse. Do not promote a slice. Do not retune the trough, the five-minute rule, or the trail. Log the verdict from result.json.
if_underpowered: Stop. Do not add sessions, do not fetch, do not widen the rule, and do not open rows.json.
declared_deviations: The signal uses the close of minute t. The fill is the SIP open of t+1.
Warm-up is the previous warehouse RTH session, not premarket.
Lines are IEX. Prices are SIP.
The five-minute pitch is the change in the same one-minute lines from t-5 to t, divided by 5. It is not a Williams %R recomputed on five-minute bars.
The exit is the one-minute stand-in for the live trail. One minute without a new high adds 60 idle seconds.
This does not replay the 12-seat book, the spread cap, or the other gates.
multiplicity: One new entry in the %R family. One grade. The closed pitch studies are not reopened.
